name: Default
shortDescription: Turns YouTube, Vimeo, SoundCloud and Twitch channels or playlists into podcast RSS feeds, downloading episodes with yt-dlp and serving them over HTTPS.

alerts.message: Podsync has no admin UI: edit the generated config.toml to add your YouTube (or Vimeo) API key and replace the sample feed, then redeploy. Feeds stay empty until a valid API key is set.
